mapper.sql: select d.*, v.version_id, v.version_no, v.version_status, v.graph_json from pm_workflow_definition d left join pm_workflow_definition_version v on v.version_id = coalesce( (select max(dv.version_id) from pm_workflow_definition_version dv where dv.definition_id = d.definition_id and dv.version_status = 'DRAFT'), d.active_version_id)
mapper.select: select d.*, v.version_id, v.version_no, v.version_status, v.graph_json from pm_workflow_definition d join pm_workflow_definition_version v on v.version_id=d.active_version_id where d.business_type=#{businessType} and d.status='ENABLED'
mapper.update: update pm_workflow_definition_version set version_status='PUBLISHED',publish_by=#{operator},publish_time=sysdate() where version_id=#{versionId} and version_status='DRAFT'
mapper.sql: select i.*, u.nick_name initiator_name from pm_workflow_instance i left join sys_user u on u.user_id=i.initiator_user_id
mapper.select: where i.business_type=#{businessType} and i.business_id=#{businessId} order by i.instance_id desc limit 1
select distinct m.user_id from pm_project_member m join pm_project_role r on r.role_id=m.role_id where m.project_id=#{projectId} and m.status='ACTIVE' and r.role_code=#{roleCode}
mapper.sql: select t.*, actor.nick_name acted_by_name from pm_workflow_task t left join sys_user actor on actor.user_id=t.acted_by_user_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from pm_workflow_instance i where i.instance_id=#{instanceId} and (i.initiator_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from pm_workflow_task t join pm_workflow_task_candidate c on c.task_id=t.task_id where t.instance_id=i.instance_id and c.user_id=#{userId}) or exists(select 1 from pm_project_member m where m.project_id=i.project_id and m.user_id=#{userId} and m.status='ACTIVE'))

select t.*, i.title, i.business_type, i.project_id, i.status instance_status, i.initiator_user_id, i.create_time instance_create_time, u.nick_name initiator_name from pm_workflow_task t join pm_workflow_instance i on i.instance_id=t.instance_id left join pm_workflow_task_candidate c on c.task_id=t.task_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=i.initiator_user_id
i.initiator_user_id=#{userId} t.acted_by_user_id=#{userId} c.user_id=#{userId} and t.status='PENDING'
order by i.create_time desc,t.node_order
mapper.update: update pm_workflow_task_candidate set read_time=coalesce(read_time,sysdate()) where task_id=#{taskId} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from pm_workflow_task_candidate c join pm_workflow_task t on t.task_id=c.task_id where c.user_id=#{userId} and c.read_time is null and t.status='PENDING'
mapper.update: update pm_workflow_task set status=#{status},acted_by_user_id=#{userId},opinion=#{opinion},acted_time=sysdate() where task_id=#{taskId} and status='PENDING' and exists( select 1 from pm_workflow_task_candidate c where c.task_id=#{taskId} and c.user_id=#{userId})
update pm_workflow_task set status='PENDING' where instance_id=#{instanceId} and status='WAITING' order by node_order limit 1
update pm_workflow_task set status='CANCELLED' where instance_id=#{instanceId} and status='WAITING'
update pm_workflow_instance set status=#{status},current_node_key=null,finish_time=sysdate(),update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where instance_id=#{instanceId} and status='RUNNING'
